Visible dark eyebrows, grey-black side hair and clearly defined dark upper-lip moustache; no clearly separated chin tuft. Preserve restrained expression. Pale note with compact unreadable dark upper marks, lower paper largely blank.

Brown/olive soft cap tilted with a small yellow badge, tan/khaki uniform collar and jacket, face angled toward viewer left. Short visible side hair and eyebrows. Very small dark upper-lip pixels cannot reliably distinguish a fine moustache from shading; do not invent a full beard. Pale note retains sparse unreadable upper marks and blank lower area.
